abha_about1: ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) adalah sistem kesehatan digital nasional India. Nomor ABHA Anda adalah ID kesehatan 14 digit yang memungkinkan catatan Anda mengikuti Anda ke berbagai rumah sakit.
abha_about2: Sehat Copilot menyusun catatan Anda dalam format FHIR yang digunakan ABDM, sehingga siap dibagikan kapan pun Anda mau.
abha_demo: Demo: simulasi sandbox ABDM, tidak ada data kesehatan nyata yang diambil.
abha_imported: ABHA se {n} naye record aa gaye.
fhir_title: ABDM / FHIR ke liye export karein
fhir_note: Aapke profile aur records ka FHIR R4 bundle banata hai.
src_hint: Jis line se padha gaya hai, use dekhne ke liye kisi value par click karein.
unread_sub: Ye line data jaisi lag rahi thi par thik se padhi nahi ja saki, isliye kuch bhi andaza nahi lagaya gaya. Agar zaroori ho toh inhein khud jod lein.
unit_skip: Dusri unit wale {n} result ki tulna nahi ki gayi hai.
consent: Upload karne par, document ko sirf padhne aur samjhane ke liye teesri party ki AI services (Google Gemini, aur backup ke liye Groq, NVIDIA ya OpenRouter) ko bheja jata hai. Hamara server kuch bhi save nahi karta. Records is device par rehte hain aur aap kisi bhi record ya saare data ko kabhi bhi mita sakte hain.
privacy: Bharat ke Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ke consent, purpose-limitation aur erasure ke niyamo par aadharit. Ye ek student prototype hai, koi certified ya audited service nahi hai. Kripya sample ya gharelu/non-sensitive documents ka istemal karein.
wipe_hint: Is device par save sab kuch hata deta hai.
err_network: Server se sampark nahi ho pa raha hai. Apna connection check karein aur dobara koshish karein.
err_type: Ye file type support nahi hota. Kripya photo, PDF ya text file ka istemal karein.
err_size: Ye file 3 MB se badi hai. Kripya choti file chunein.
err_image: Ye image padhi nahi ja saki. Dusri photo try karein.
err_generic: Kuch galat ho gaya. Kripya dobara koshish karein.
